entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready transparent PNG sprite for TinySeaWar, a polished 2D anime naval tactics game. STRICT orthographic TOP DOWN dorsal view, ZERO perspective or side view, nose points exactly RIGHT, wings vertical on canvas, bilateral symmetry around horizontal fuselage. Entire airplane fully visible centered with ample empty alpha margin. Painted anime game asset with restrained navy slate-blue metal, warm ivory wing tip panels, dark crisp outline, simple readable large shapes, subtle cel shading, amber cockpit canopy. Neutral shared aircraft for all factions. Flying with landing gear fully RETRACTED. No bombs attached, no shadow, no glow, no halo, no trail, no smoke, no ground, no ocean, no background, no labels, no text, no logos, no national or political markings, no decorative circle. Only a single intact airplane. Needs recognizable silhouette when downscaled to 24 pixels. A single crisp propeller cross may be drawn, no motion blur. Genuine transparent background, not a checkerboard painting. Aircraft spans about 75 percent of canvas, with no parts clipped.
